title: Remove KI-Basics as a standalone portfolio category

scope: six-item shared navigation across all HTML pages
remove the KI-Basics overview and its two standalone KI-method pages
preserve the Cash-Forecast route and classify its surrounding navigation solely as Datenanalyse
remove the homepage KI route activation, expertise node, and KI-only outro link
remove KI-only CSS identity and artwork rules
record the resulting DESIGN.md reconciliation item

moving or renaming the established Cash-Forecast URL

removed KI-only pages and image asset
